questions: Hi there! I'm excited to get to know you. When you have free time, what do you enjoy doing the most?
Nice! Which school subjects do you enjoy the most, and what do you like about them?
Do you like making things look good, like drawing or designing, or figuring out how things work?
Can you tell me about a time something was hard to do? What did you try?
What games, apps or websites do you love, and what makes them fun for you?
Do you like working in a team or on your own? Tell me why.
